sentences.text: We have heard the learned Counsel for the Applicant/Petitioner and the learned APP for the Respondent-State and have perused the documents on record.

We find that the Applicant/Petitioner has already been permitted to travel out of India by an order dated 9 th November 2023 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, City Civil and Sessions Court, Greater Bombay on certain terms and conditions during the period 10 th November 2023 to 9th November 2025.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, City Civil and Sessions Court, Greater Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, on reaching the Airport, he learnt about issuance of the LOC.
Thereafter, he filed an application before this Court seeking permission to travel to Tanzania from 22nd March 2024 to 22nd April 2024.
The said application was allowed by order dated 20 th March 2024 passed by this Court on certain terms and conditions.
In terms of the conditions of the said order, the Applicant/Petitioner furnished an undertaking in respect of his travel outside India.
4. Now he seeks to travel abroad for the period from 11 th May 2024 to 11th November 2024.
Since the petition is listed today i.e. on 15 th May 2024, the Applicant/Petitioner modifies his request to travel from 18 th May 2024 to 16th July 2024.
The Applicant/Petitioner intends to travel to Tanzania in connection with his work and the charge-sheet is yet to be filed.

5. Considering this fact and also that he was already permitted to travel abroad by previous orders of this Court as well as the learned Sessions Court and has complied with the conditions imposed by the previous orders, we deem it appropriate to allow the Applicant/Petitioner to travel as per the itinerary tendered in the Court today indicated in the air ticket purchased by him.
The air ticket is taken on record and marked "X1" for identification.
_____Page No. 2 of 3____  15th May 2024  Gitalaxmi

6 . In view of this, we permit the Applicant/Petitioner to travel to Tanzania as per the itinerary as per the air ticket annexed hereto, which shall form part and parcel of the order, for the period from 18 th May 2024 till 16th July 2024.

This order will also be subject to the usual conditions, viz.:-
a.

The Applicant/Petitioner is to file an undertaking to return to this country at the end of this period, if not already done;
b.

entities.text: Viran Kanubhai Patel vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Applicant/Petitioner must file an undertaking (if not already done) not to apply for renewal or extension of this order until he returns to this country.
7.
Subject to these conditions, the LOC in question against the Applicant/Petitioner is stayed until 17th July 2024.

8. The immigration authorities at all ports of departure including all airports will permit the Applicant/Petitioner to passage and permit the Applicant/Petitioner to take his flights out of the country.
9. The immigration authorities will not ask for a certified copy of this order, but will act on presentation of an authenticated or digitally signed copy of this order.
10. The Interim Application is disposed of in these terms.
There will be no order as to costs.
